io_comparison.scope: Three paired repetitions, alternating order, fresh database per variant/repetition. Production live FUSE with direct_io and FULL synchronous WAL; metadata TTL 60 s for both variants; hot OS cache. Agent-owned builds/tests finished before measurement; unrelated builds and services were active on the shared host. Sequential write includes flush/fsync/close. Fixture preparation and validation are untimed.

64_mib.scope: Diagnostic only: unchanged 9ee791a625 core with per-connection settings on disposable databases. All variants use FULL; native writes reproduce 1048528+48 FUSE splitting. Linker wrappers count syncs and SQL, so timings include instrumentation. Checkpoint and close costs are also recorded.

fuse_sanitizer.limitation: Process-kill cases do not simulate hardware power loss; SIGKILL prevents exit-time leak diagnostics.

validation.scope: Only affected component tests; no full repository suite.

limitations: Shared host with unrelated jobs; no owned builds/tests overlap measurement.
Passive checkpoint trigger is not a WAL size cap.
FULL per-mutation commits remain; write commit count is unchanged.
Read medians decline in these FUSE samples; closing costs and outliers are retained.
Diagnostic timings include linker-wrapper overhead and are not FUSE throughput.
